description: WorkspaceService must force reload for build.rs edits and other inputs that can rerun build scripts, without broad repo-wide invalidation on unrelated files. The current auxiliary watcher is too broad and still misses some build-script-relevant tracked files.

notes.author: darin@book
notes.content: Audit: verified in /Users/darin/Projects/raql on jj change 1902740de17e. Build-script invalidation now derives rerun paths from build.rs, forces reload for tracked rerun inputs and build.rs edits, and stops broad unrelated-file invalidation when rerun-if-changed narrowed the input set. Verification: cargo test -p raql-daemon && cargo test -p raql-host-ra && cargo test --test cli_daemon_cutover -- --nocapture && cargo test --test cli_strict_runtime -- --nocapture.

title: Make build-script invalidation precise for build.rs and rerun inputs
